description: Overlapping effective intervals within one job (person, position, suffix)
rule: next valid_from <= previous valid_to on the current-knowledge chain

description: Gap between consecutive Active rows of the same job
rule: next valid_from > previous valid_to + 1 day, both Active

description: Appointment row with no position version effective on its start date
rule: no T_POSN_HIST row with valid_from <= event_date <= valid_to (current knowledge)

description: Appointment row whose position does not exist at all
rule: position_id absent from T_POSN_HIST

description: Terminated person with an Active appointment effective after the termination date
rule: x_separation.term_date < Active row valid_to and no later rehire row starts after the termination

description: Termination record with no Terminated appointment row on that date
rule: x_separation row without an appointment row of terminated status starting on term_date

description: FTE outside (0, 1.0] on Active rows (fraction assumption)
rule: fte IS NULL OR fte <= 0 OR fte > 1.0; appointment percent outside (0, 100]

description: FTE-adjusted annual salary outside the position's POSN_MIN_SAL..POSN_MAX_SAL range
rule: annual_salary / fte < min*(1-0.005) or > max*(1+0.005) on Active rows; position version effective at the row start

description: Position version with a missing or inverted salary range
rule: range_min IS NULL OR range_max IS NULL OR range_min > range_max

description: Active appointment rows with no supervisor (current rows at the extract date)
rule: supervisor_person_id IS NULL on rows effective at the extract date

description: Supervisor cycles (self-supervision or A<->B) among current rows
rule: person supervises themself, or their supervisor's supervisor is them

description: Supervisor id that is not a person with any appointment
rule: supervisor_person_id not in the appointment table

description: Appointment rows deleted in source (CUR_INFO_IND = D); excluded from current knowledge
rule: is_deleted

description: Employment rows deleted in source (CUR_INFO_IND = D)
rule: current_info_ind in deleted values

description: Position rows deleted in source (CUR_INFO_IND = D)
rule: current_info_ind in deleted values

description: Duplicate primary key (person, position, suffix, eff_date, recorded_start)
rule: count(*) > 1 per key

description: Lineage with more than one open (currently known) version
rule: more than one row with known_to = open end per (person, position, suffix, eff_date)

description: Appointment person with no person record
rule: person_id not in the person table

description: Appointment person with no employment record
rule: person_id not in the employment table

description: Employment row whose effective interval is not covered by any appointment of the person (current knowledge)
rule: no appointment row overlapping [valid_from, least(valid_to, extract)] for Active employment rows

description: Class key with no role family (Unassigned)
rule: x_class.role_family_source = 'unassigned'

description: Position class with no job-progression ladder
rule: x_ladder.ladder_code IS NULL

description: Rows effective after the extract date (Future)
rule: valid_from > extract date

description: Late-keyed rows: first known more than 30 days after they took effect
rule: min(known_from) over the row's lineage (all versions) - valid_from > 30 days

description: Restricted or fairness-only fields exposed in the canonical person view
rule: mapping roles restricted / restricted_fairness_only must be hidden
